Definition
[Logarithmic Sobolev inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0227 1. ch22:22.14\group Logarithmic Sobolev

A Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ satisfies a logarithmic Sobolev inequality if some $C_P>-\infty $ satisfies \[ \int _{\mathcal M}\left( rac12| abla f|^2+f-n ight)u\, d\mu \ge C_P \] for every $u=(2\pi )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$ with $\int u\, d\mu =1$. Equivalently, for $\psi \in W^{1,2}$, \[ \int (2| abla \psi |^2-\psi ^2\log \psi ^2) +\log \! \left(\int \psi ^2 ight)\int \psi ^2 \ge \left( frac n2\log (2\pi )+n+C_P ight)\int \psi ^2. \]
